The phrase "came unto me" is often a biblical euphemism for sexual intercourse, and since Rahab was a "harlot", there might have been some of that going on here.

If it seems wrong to serve the Lord, choose whom you will serve [12], the gods of your fathers or the gods of the Amorites.

But I and my family will serve the Lord.

items.html: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

blocks.html:
All the people answered simultaneously, saying,
God forbid that we should reject the Lord to serve other gods.

items.html: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

blocks.html: Because he brought us out of Egypt, did all those great things in our sight, and protected us wherever we went.

items.html: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he is our God.

blocks.html:
He drove out everyone, even the Amorites.

So we'll seve him as our God.

items.html: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

blocks.html:
Joshua said to the people,
You can't serve the Lord, because he is a holy and jealous God.

He won't forgive you sins. [13]

items.html: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

blocks.html: If you forsake the Lord, he'll turn on you, hurt you, and consume you, even though he was good to you before.

items.html: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.

blocks.html:
The people said to Joshua,
Okay, we'll serve the Lord.

items.html: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

blocks.html:
Joshua said to the people,
You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the Lord.
The people said,
We are witnesses.

items.html: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.

blocks.html:
Joshua said to the people,
Okay then, put away your strange gods and turn your hearts to the God of Israel.

items.html: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

blocks.html:
The people said to Joshua,
We'll serve the Lord and obey his voice.

items.html: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

blocks.html: So Joshua made an agreement with the people and established laws in Shechem.

items.html: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.

blocks.html: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a big stone and set it under an oak, near the sanctuary of the Lord.

items.html: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

blocks.html:
Joshua said to all the people,
This stone is a witness to us. [14]

It will be a witness to you, if you ever reject your God.

items.html: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

blocks.html: Then Joshua let the people go home.
Joshua dies
24:29-33, Cf. Jg 2:8

items.html: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

blocks.html: Joshua died at the age of 110.

items.html: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

blocks.html: They buried him north of the hill of Gaash.

items.html: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.

blocks.html: Everyone in Israel served God while Joshua was alive.

items.html: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

blocks.html: They also buried the bones of Joseph [15] in Shechem, in a parcel of land bought by Joseph from the father of Shechem for 100 pieces of silver. [16]

items.html: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

blocks.html: Eleazar the son of Aaron also died. They buried him on a hill that belonged to his son Phinehas.
